fields.options: I am responsible for the above described animal and have the ability to give you my permission to groom under anesthesia I acknowledge that there are certain risks to anesthesia and treatment that could involve serious bodily injury or death to my pet and that these risks are present in any procedure that requires a general or intravenous anesthetics and treatment. I agree to the use of anesthesia as considered necessary and advisable by the Veterinarian. I am aware that upon grooming skin problem may be observed by the groomer and if such arises I have to be informed and I shall bring my pet to the veterinarian in the establishment and shall not make issues that the establishment was responsible for such action. I am aware that this is a veterinary center that my pet is not alone in the grooming room or other rooms and other patient exist in the same room. The establishment has made all precautionary measures for preventing contamination / infestation of diseases according to their capabilities.
